title: Safe manipulation of tops-only voting rules
abstract: arXiv:2611.18282v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study tops-only voting rules on the domain of all preferences with a unique top, focusing on manipulation by risk-avoiding voters. Following Hartman et al.(2025), we measure resistance to manipulation by the RAT-degree: the minimum number of other voters' reports that a voter needs to observe for a ``safe'' manipulation to become possible. Given the observed reports, such a manipulation weakly improves on truthful reporting under every completion of the unobserved reports and strictly improves on it under at least one completion. For any finite set of at least three alternatives, we show that anonymity, unanimity, and winner monotonicity imply an upper bound of $\lceil n/2\rceil$ on the RAT-degree, where $n$ is the number of voters. We provide exact characterizations of the RAT-degree for anonymous generalized median voter schemes and voting by quotas, without imposing single-peakedness or separability on preferences. translated_title: 仅依赖首位偏好的投票规则的安全操纵
translated_abstract: 我们在所有具有唯一首位偏好的偏好域上研究仅依赖首位偏好的投票规则，重点关注规避风险的选民所实施的操纵。沿用Hartman等人(2025)的方法，我们用RAT度来衡量规则对操纵的抵抗能力：RAT度是指选民需要观察到其他选民报告的最小数量，才能使一次“安全”操纵成为可能。在给定所观察到的报告的情况下，这种操纵在未被观察报告的每一种补全下都弱优于真实报告，并且在至少一种补全下严格优于真实报告。对于任何包含至少三个备选方案的有限集合，我们证明匿名性、全体一致性和胜者单调性意味着RAT度存在上界⌈n/2⌉，其中n为选民数量。在不对偏好施加单峰性或可分性假设的前提下，我们为匿名广义中位选民方案和配额投票提供了RAT度的精确刻画。对于奇数n……
tldr: 该论文在规避风险选民的框架下研究仅依赖首位偏好投票规则的安全操纵抵抗性，证明了匿名性、全体一致性和胜者单调性共同蕴含RAT度上界为⌈n/2⌉，并在无需单峰性或可分性假设下给出了广义中位选民方案和配额投票的RAT度精确刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper studies safe manipulation of tops-only voting rules by risk-avoiding voters, proving that anonymity, unanimity, and winner monotonicity imply a RAT-degree upper bound of ⌈n/2⌉, and providing exact characterizations of the RAT-degree for anonymous generalized median voter schemes and voting by quotas without imposing single-peakedness or separability.
